title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction: Clearing Cushion on Retention Remittances
content:
## Clearing cushion — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the clearing cushion is part of the retention remittance.

The clearing cushion is per diem collected in advance against funds being credited after the statement's good-through date, and whatever of it is not needed for that per diem is refunded with the held excess. It is the per diem the payoff case carries times the plan's late-funds tolerance of 5 calendar days when the loan's maturity case, under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, is referred to foreclosure, and the flat USD 100.00 extension cushion when the maturity case is in its extension period; a case in any other status takes no cushion (0.00).

| Maturity case status | Clearing cushion |
|---|---|
| referred to foreclosure | the per diem on the case times 5 |
| in its extension period | USD 100.00 |
| due and payable, or any other status | none |

*Hypothetical:* with a per diem of USD 41.20 on the case, a maturity case referred to foreclosure gives a cushion of USD 206.00 (5 days); a case in its extension period gives USD 100.00 whatever the per diem; a due-and-payable case gives none.
